anomalies.description: A bald, bearded man in a vest grabs and shoves another man at a table, initiating a physical altercation.
A violent physical fight erupts in the bar involving multiple individuals, including a bald man and others, with visible grappling, throwing, and striking actions.
A person is seen lying on a pool table while another individual leans over them in an aggressive posture, suggesting assault on a helpless victim.
A violent physical fight occurs in a dimly lit bar: one person is thrown onto a pool table (f1), and another bald man is struck and falls (f2–f4).

A bald man lies on the floor, visibly injured with blood on his face, while another individual looms over him; subsequent frames show him screaming and writhing in pain, indicating he is being attacked or has just been severely beaten while helpless.

A bald man lies on the floor, visibly injured with blood on his face and mouth, while being kicked or struck repeatedly (f5–f14); he is motionless and defenseless, indicating abuse rather than mutual combat.
